about.title: About LibPDF
about.lede: An open, quiet digital library and reading repository. Built for searching, indexing, and downloading literary volumes with zero tracking and automatic local storage.
about.missionTitle: Our Mission: A Quiet Space for Literature
about.missionP1: LibPDF was conceived as an alternative to modern attention-driven platforms. Rather than behavioral profiling, advertisements, or algorithms dictating reading habits, LibPDF acts as a timeless digital catalog and ledger.
about.missionP2: Every volume in our index is cataloged with direct access to open digital formats, including standard Adobe PDF files and reflowable EPUB editions for mobile e-readers.
about.archivesP: We leverage open metadata and public scans from non-profit repositories such as Open Library, Internet Archive, and Standard Ebooks. By prioritizing decentralized hotlinks, our architecture avoids bulky media storage while keeping literary classics freely readable in any web browser.
about.privacyP: Your reading notes, vocabulary, and shelf history belong entirely to you. LibPDF operates without third-party tracking cookies, user profiling, or invasive surveillance scripts.

features.title: Core Features
features.lede: Explore the tools and infrastructure powering the LibPDF open digital library, reading ledger, and e-book download hub.
features.f1Desc: Every book in our digital repository provides direct download triggers for both print-formatted PDF documents and reflowable EPUB e-reader files.
features.f2Desc: Experience fluid layout animations powered by Framer Motion. Filter by available format, author, or genre in milliseconds without full page reloads.
features.f3Desc: Encountered an unfamiliar word while reading? Record its phonetic pronunciation, part of speech, and definition, tagged directly to the source volume.
features.f4Desc: Automated generation of bilingual XML sitemaps partitioned into 5,000-URL chunks, complete with Schema.org Book JSON-LD markup and hreflang tags.

landing.heroTitle: An open digital library: search any volume, read online, or download as PDF & EPUB.
landing.heroSub: Search millions of books, read directly in your browser, or download in PDF and EPUB. Automatically saved to your local device with zero sign-in, zero passwords, and zero tracking.
landing.sec1Title: Search it, download it, save it locally
landing.sec1Desc: Search any book, read page-by-page in your browser, or download direct PDF and EPUB e-reader files. Everything you view, favorite, or annotate is automatically preserved on your local device without creating an account.
landing.sec2Desc: Every volume includes a private visual writing studio. Highlight key passages with paint highlighters, color-code insights, format blockquotes, and structure takeaways — all saved locally without an account.
landing.sec3Desc: Track books per year, pages read, genres, and ratings. Click into interactive monthly activity bars to inspect the exact volumes and reading velocity behind your stats.
landing.sec4Desc: Encountered a rare word while reading? Look up definitions, phonetics, and contextual quotes, tagged directly to the source volume in your personal lexicon.
landing.why1Desc: Your reading data is strictly yours. No tracking scripts, no behavioral profiling, no data resale.
landing.why2Desc: Strict privacy compliance under European data protection standards.
landing.why3Desc: Zero heavy cloud media hosting. Scraped bibliographic metadata stays compact and fast.
landing.startDesc: It takes seconds, and your first volume is a search away.
